== Editing the family navigator ==
Shared Versions navigator for the Premiere [[Luke Skywalker]] publication family across Decipher, Virtual Original, Virtual Legacy and Virtual Modern. Every listed publication includes <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Luke Skywalker (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its infobox.

To edit the navigator manually:
# Click '''Edit versions''' at the bottom of the Versions cell on any family article. Sign in with your wiki editing account if necessary. The link opens the shared template's source editor.
# Find the relevant era and set group. Each publication's <code>Card version link</code> call is on its own line. Preserve the surrounding HTML comment markers; they keep source line breaks from adding space to the displayed list. Change <code>label</code> to adjust the displayed wording, or <code>page</code> to correct its full canonical article destination. The current-article highlighting is automatic.
# Use '''Show changes''' to review your edit, then save with an edit summary. Open a family article to check the rendered navigator; dependent-page caches can require refreshing. All sixteen connected articles use the saved family list.
# For a newly verified publication, add its entry once and configure its full article to include the same family template. Check both the new article and existing family members.

Example publication entry:
<pre><nowiki>{{Card version link|page=Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)|label=PC Remastered|current={{{current|{{FULLPAGENAME}}}}}}}</nowiki></pre>

Add a verified publication once in the appropriate era and set group. Use its canonical article title and a concise label; retain the full article title and publication details on the article. Configure the new article to include the same navigator. Preserve the existing entries and their order. The current article highlights automatically.

The optional <code>current</code> parameter supports [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT/Luke versions pilot|sandbox previews]]. A template change can require dependent-page cache refreshes; verify the rendered family after publishing. Restore the saved pre-edit revisions to revert the pilot, using revision guards to preserve intervening edits.
</noinclude>
